details: Finance ops tracker built and shipped independently. CloseMate is a self-contained, browser-based month-end
close tracker — no login, no setup, no backend. Built in HTML/JS in under 5 hours. It has four modules: a live close
dashboard, a categorised task checklist with owner and status tracking, a reconciliation tracker with variance flags,
and an issues log with escalation paths useful for Project/Program Managers.
